options.name: addr1
options.description: Domain Controller Server Address1. Enter the IP address of Active Directory server.

options.name: addr2
options.description: Domain Controller Server Address2. Enter the IP address of Active Directory server.

options.name: addr3
options.description: Domain Controller Server Address3. Enter the IP address of Active Directory server.

options.name: code
options.description: Secret Password. Specify the Password of the administrator.

options.name: domain
options.description: User Domain Name. Specify the Domain Name for the user for example MyDomain.com.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: name
options.description: Secret Username. Specify the Username of an administrator of the Active Directory Server.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The Time Out configuration(15-300). Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.
